mapper.select: SELECT l.id, l.plate_no AS plateNo, l.enter_time AS enterTime, l.leave_time AS leaveTime, l.park_duration AS parkDuration, l.status, l.station_id AS stationId, s.name AS stationName, l.remark, l.proof_image AS proofImage, l.is_corrected AS isCorrected, l.reserve1, l.reserve2, l.creator, l.updater, l.create_time AS createTime, l.update_time AS updateTime FROM leave_record l LEFT JOIN station_info s ON l.station_id = s.id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE l.id = #{id} AND l.deleted = 0

SELECT DATE(l.leave_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM leave_record l WHERE l.deleted = 0
AND l.leave_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime})
AND l.leave_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime})
AND l.station_id = #{stationId}
GROUP BY DATE(l.leave_time) ORDER BY date

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(l.leave_time, '%H:00') AS hour, COUNT(*) AS count FROM leave_record l WHERE l.deleted = 0
AND l.leave_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime})
AND l.leave_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime})
AND l.station_id = #{stationId}
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(l.leave_time, '%H:00') ORDER BY hour

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leave_record l WHERE l.deleted = 0 AND l.leave_time >= CURDATE() AND l.leave_time < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY
AND l.leave_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime})
AND l.leave_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime})
AND l.station_id = #{stationId}

SELECT COALESCE(MAX(cnt), 0) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM leave_record l WHERE l.deleted = 0 AND l.leave_time >= CURDATE() AND l.leave_time < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY
AND l.leave_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime})
AND l.leave_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime})
AND l.station_id = #{stationId}
GROUP BY HOUR(l.leave_time) ) t
